Name: Azel, Son of Eleasah
Summary: Son of Eleasah and father of Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 8:37; 1 Chronicles 9:43: Son of Eleasah and father of Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Azel stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
